title: Odds momentum
description: How this venue's odds of Up have been moving, in probability points. Odds that keep drifting one way are usually following a spot move.

return_pp_30s.label: Change 30s
return_pp_30s.description: How much the odds of Up moved over the last thirty seconds, in probability points. Positive means the venue is warming to Up.

return_pp_1m.label: Change 1m
return_pp_1m.description: How much the odds of Up moved over the last minute, in probability points. Positive means the venue is warming to Up.

return_pp_5m.label: Change 5m
return_pp_5m.description: How much the odds of Up moved over the last five minutes, in probability points. The slow drift behind the shorter reads.

direction_1m.label: Odds direction 1m
direction_1m.description: Up or down once the one-minute change clears a small threshold, otherwise flat. The one-word version of the change.
